column1: # Upstream files and functions this section deliberately does NOT port, and why.
# A file absent from both this list and PORTED_MAP.tsv has simply not been
# looked at, which is a different and worse state. Keep both complete.
# Pins: RAFT v26.08.00, cuML v26.08.00, cuVS 94c2819 (25.08). Paths are
# relative to the repository named in the first path component.

column2: CANNOT BE PORTED OR CHECKED: NOT ON THIS MACHINE
column3: The 26.08 cuVS that cuML 26.08 compiles against is in no checkout here. This lane's cuvs/ files were written against it by an agent that is gone, so their line citations cannot be confirmed and three numbers in them are recorded as CHOSEN (DEVIATION 780). GETTING THAT CHECKOUT IS THE SINGLE HIGHEST-VALUE THING ANYONE CAN DO FOR THIS LANE: it settles ncv, max_iterations, whether tolerance is plumbed, whether the COO or the CSR Laplacian overload is the 26.08 path, and whether the transform COO overloads exist

cuML 26.08's spectral_clustering.cu includes it and calls cuvs::cluster::spectral::fit_predict; neither the header nor the symbol exists in the 25.08 checkout. SpectralClusteringParams' field list here is inferred from cuML's to_cuvs (n_clusters, n_components, n_init, n_neighbors, tolerance, rng_state) and is unconfirmed

column2: not the path we ported, AND THAT CHOICE IS CONTINGENT
column3: The two overloads agree on every VALUE and not on every ROUNDING: the CSR kernel excludes a self-loop from the degree (`input_value = col_index == row ? 0 : adj_values[...]`, :69) while the COO overload SUMS it in and SUBTRACTS it back on the diagonal (:224-226), which is two roundings where the CSR arm has none. The kNN connectivity graph always carries a self-loop, so the two arms can differ in the last bits of every diagonal entry. This lane ported the COO arm. **cuVS 25.08 REACHES THE CSR ARM** (coo_to_csr_matrix at spectral_embedding.cu:111-145 hands create_laplacian a device_csr_matrix_view). If the 26.08 cuVS also converts to CSR, THIS LANE PORTED THE WRONG OVERLOAD and the fix is to port the CSR kernel beside it. Nothing on this machine can settle that

A thrust::sort by |eigenvalue| and then a re-sort by algebraic value. thrust::sort is NOT stable, so the order among equal magnitudes is unspecified and theirs never defined a tie-break; porting it would mean inventing one, which is exactly what this lane's contract forbids. cuVS only ever passes LA

`raft::linalg::transpose(handle, V_k, V_k_T.view())` computes a transpose that the gemv two lines later does not read (it passes V_k.data_handle()). Not ported, because porting it would move nothing and cost a kernel

kernel_triangular_populate is launched <<<blockSize, numBlocks>>> where its neighbor at :165-168 uses <<<blocksPerGrid, threadsPerBlock>>>: the arguments are transposed, so it runs 256 blocks of ceil(ncv/256) threads. It happens to COVER every row at every ncv and writes each cell once, so no bit moves. Recorded rather than reproduced; ours builds the projected matrix in a host loop
A different solver. Nothing in the spectral embedding path calls it

Support for randomized_svds. NOTE for a later reader: svds_sign_correction.cuh is RAFT's own answer to the sign-convention problem this lane solves with DEVIATION 770, on a different decomposition. Worth reading before anyone proposes a second sign rule
Minimum spanning tree. A different algorithm in the same directory

column1: raft: cpp/include/raft/spectral/partition.cuh, modularity_maximization.cuh, detail/spectral_util.cuh, cluster_solvers.cuh, eigen_solvers.cuh
column3: The legacy RAFT spectral partitioning stack. cuVS 25.08's cpp/src/sparse/cluster/detail/spectral.cuh (fit_embedding) is built on it, with maxiter 4000, tol 0.01 and restart_iter = 15 + neigvs "what cugraph is using", and it feeds a NO-OP cluster solver. cuML 26.08 does not reach any of it. Not ported, and named here because the file name spectral.cuh appears on BOTH paths and is the single easiest thing in this port to confuse
A cuSOLVER/LAPACK wrapper. Its role here is filled by symmetric_eig_host (DEVIATION 771)
Present in the 25.08 tree only. Named so a reader who greps the wrong checkout does not think it was missed

column2: NOT PORTED, AND IT IS THE ALTERNATIVE TO OUR REFUSAL
column3: RAFT can COALESCE duplicate (row, col) entries by summing them. This lane REFUSES a repeated key instead (DEVIATIONS 775/777). If a caller ever legitimately needs a graph with duplicates, this is the function to port, and the refusal becomes a fallback rather than the policy

DEVIATION 772. Roughly 600 lines of generator whose only output in this path is a start vector. Ours is a splitmix64 hashed uniform, exact, a pure function of (seed, n). The eigenpairs Lanczos CONVERGES to do not depend on v0 to the tolerance; the bits of the trajectory do, which is why the card records v0
The from-kNN-arrays symmetrize used elsewhere in RAFT. cuVS builds the COO itself and calls coo_symmetrize

column1: raft: cpp/include/raft/sparse/linalg/detail/degree.cuh, add.cuh, norm.cuh, transpose.h, masked_matmul.cuh, sddmm.hpp, spmm.hpp
column3: Nothing in cuVS's spectral embedding calls them

The estimator surface: n_components defaulting to n_clusters when None, n_neighbors=10, n_init=10, eigen_tol='auto' meaning cuVS's 1e-5, and the refusals of affinity outside {nearest_neighbors, precomputed} and assign_labels != 'kmeans'. Those are the caller's contract and are documented in README's HAND-OFF section so a binding author does not have to rediscover them
Same, plus the one piece of arithmetic that lives in Python: config.n_components = n_components + 1 when drop_first (:294). This lane's transform receives THAT number, exactly as cuVS's does
UMAP's spectral initialization, a different caller of the same primitives

column1: spectral: a CERTIFICATE gate for symmetric_eig_host
column3: Seam J4 (DEVIATION 781) and the sweep cap (C4) both live in a solver SHARED by the device arm and the oracle, so a device-equals-oracle compare cannot see a change to either. MOJOLEARN_SPECTRAL_SABOTAGE_SWEEP_CAP is caught by the closed-form check; MOJOLEARN_SPECTRAL_SABOTAGE_ROTATE_UNFUSED is caught by nothing. An FNV hash of the solver's output on a pinned fixture, asserted against a literal, closes it. Written down rather than done because it needs a compile slot to produce the literal

column1: spectral: a fixture that makes max_iterations bite
column3: Every fixture here converges long before either 10n or 1000, so the C2 sabotage is expected inert. A bound no fixture reaches is a bound no gate tests
